name: Masked Identity, Improved
body:
You are better at keeping your identities separate.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 5th, Masked Identity or dual identity class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +5 bonus on Disguise checks to appear as your current identity, increasing to +10 at 10th level. This bonus stacks with seamless disguise.

Special: If you possess a class feature that provides a second identity (such as the chaotic vigilante class feature of the brute archetype), you can treat it as dual identity for the prerequisites of this feat.
